title: Canonical algebraization of coherent formal systems under cohomological-dimension-one depth bounds

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit prerequisite boundary
standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Dualizing complexes, coherent formal modules, local-cohomology finiteness from depth, adic completion, finite modules over complete rings and Mittag–Leffler limits. The source-local topology and canonical-extension criterion are retained.

core_obligations: Identify the inverse-limit topology with theI-adic topology and prove finiteness of the section and obstruction modules from the stated pro-isomorphic depth-bounded system.
Control the successive obstruction submodules through the cohomological-dimension-one system and the Mittag–Leffler argument to satisfy the canonical-extension criterion.

proof_roadmap.step: Identify the inverse-limit topology with theI-adic topology and prove finiteness of the section and obstruction modules from the stated pro-isomorphic depth-bounded system.
Control the successive obstruction submodules through the cohomological-dimension-one system and the Mittag–Leffler argument to satisfy the canonical-extension criterion.

difficulty_reason: The statement is canonical extension of an entire inverse system, not an algebraization of one finite truncation. Compatibility and vanishing of the limiting obstruction system supply concrete H2 obligations.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.

dedup.scope: Compared fixed tag/file/claim against local manifest, same-chapter primary titles/locators, 400 retired claims, research main-overlap and preparation worklist. Related standard tools and included support are not separately counted. No remote freshness or historical novelty asserted.
